easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Omni-Changeling.
description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Omni-Changeling. Choose to have Omni-Changeling enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
